.. _SCM_TTL:

TTL
===

Returns the current Time to Live (TTL) of an audio stream.

Arguments
---------

+-------------+------------+---------------------------------------------------------------+
| Name        | Type       | Description                                                   |
+=============+============+===============================================================+
| stream_id   | ``String`` | ASCII ID of the audio stream.                                 |
+-------------+------------+---------------------------------------------------------------+

Output
------

+--------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Type         | Description                                                                                            |
+==============+========================================================================================================+
| ``Integer``  | Returns -1 if no TTL has been set for the audio stream. Otherwise, returns the current TTL in seconds. |
+--------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Example
-------

.. code-block:: scheme

    ;; SCM expression
    (ttl "vocals")

Using ``EVAL``:

.. code-block:: none

    EVAL '(ttl \"vocals\")'
